chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, raising it, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When you have a doubt in the Glorification (Tasbih) of Fatima Al-Zahra (peace be upon her), so repeat it.

key_terms.تَسْبِيحِ: Glorification (specifically referring to the Tasbih of Fatima Al-Zahra)
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ: Fatima Al-Zahra, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What should one do if they doubt whether they have finished reciting the Tasbih of Fatima?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) advising that if one doubts the completion of the Tasbih of Fatima (AS), they should repeat it, reflecting the principle of *al-istishab* (presumption of continuity) in Shia jurisprudence. This ruling underscores the high status of this specific dhikr, treating its completion with the same rigor as obligatory acts to ensure spiritual perfection after Salah.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘When you have a doubt in the Glorification (Tasbīḥ) of Syeda Fatima Al-Zahraasws, so repeat’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Ahmad in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If you face uncertainty about Tasbih of Fatimah al- Zahra’, ‘Alayha al-Salam, say it again.’”
